the degree of the instability of a nondegenerate equilibrium is odd if and only if the Morse index of its corresponding potential is odd.
the degree of stability of a non-degenerative equilibrium position of a dynamical dissipative system is equal to its Morse index.
the degree of an equilibrium position is equal to the index of the potential at this position.

the problem of the degree of instability for the equilibrium points of a system of ordinary differential equations.
the stability of equilibrium positions in dissipative systems.
the stability of the motion of a rigid body in a liquid.
